title: A Map and the Sap
lines: Sam and Pam sat at the mat.
Sam and Pam and Tam tap at the sap.

questions.ask: Who was sitting at the map at the start?
questions.listenFor: Sam. It is the first line. If your child is stuck, point at that line and let them read it again rather than telling them.

questions.ask: What did they find at the mat?
questions.listenFor: Sap, the sticky juice that runs out of a tree. Line six says it. If they say sticky, that counts.

questions.ask: If you drew a map, where would it take us? Tell me why there.
questions.listenFor: Any place is a good answer. You are listening for the reason, and it is a lovely chance to draw a map together after.
